carpark_gate_lock.mechanism: Car 34 (returning, passing through the shared lot) is first on the outside approach lane 20:18:2:4 and needs gate 19,18. The gate is owned by car 10 (outbound to destination 34), queued behind car 34 on 20:17:2:2. TryCarparkGate measures an outbound car's gate distance to the start of its final road lane (car 10: 0.157) but a connector user's distance to the carpark connector (car 34: 0.78), so the car behind ranks nearer. Car 10 cannot reach the gate past car 34; car 34 cannot enter without the gate; car 43 then backs up at the other gate.
carpark_gate_lock.relation_to_this_change: The gate rule (Mohammad's 74-suite approach gate plus shared transit) is untouched by the arbitration change, and no link of this lock is a junction-arbitration decision; the changed traffic exposed it. Not measured on the previous engine.
